parsed.explanation: Documented hostility with thin recourse drives this: a 2023 human-rights report records bias-motivated violence and discrimination in daily life; no SOGI protection law, no LGBT organizations or helpline means no realistic remedy (tier 3). The 2024 High Court upholding of the conduct ban provides social license, and the 2019 fraud charge against a cross-dressing teenager shows a state lever reaching gender nonconformity, though withdrawn. Offsetting: no trans-specific offence, no entry-screening, facility or document rule sourced, no organized or state-directed targeting, incidents are scattered and dated, and the head of government condemned the 2018 attacks. No documented acceptance either, so thin data extrapolates from criminalization, absent recognition and stigma toward risk rather than safety. Universal-exposure measures are absent, keeping this out of lower tiers.
